## `get_citations`

**Get Citations.** Read-only. Reaches outside the server.

Fetch papers that cite the given paper (forward citations).

Returns at most 1000 citing papers per call; a larger ``limit`` is capped
at 1000, so page further with ``offset``.

Paging deeply to satisfy ``min_citations`` can run long; such a call
continues in the background and returns a job handle to poll with
``get_job_result``.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | `string` | required | Paper identifier (DOI, S2 ID, ARXIV:, etc.). |
| `fields` | `compact \| standard \| full` | `"compact"` | Field set preset for returned paper records. |
| `limit` | `integer` | `20` | Max results (pagination, max 1000). |
| `offset` | `integer` | `0` | Pagination offset. |
| `year_start` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Filter citing papers published from this year. |
| `year_end` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Filter citing papers published up to this year. |
| `fields_of_study` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Filter by field of study. |
| `min_citations` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Minimum citation count of citing papers. Applied client-side (S2 does not support this filter on the citations endpoint). Papers with unknown citation counts are excluded. Pagination (``offset``/``limit``) is applied to the filtered results. The tool paginates through up to 10 000 upstream results to find qualifying papers. |

**Returns**

JSON with ``data`` list of ``{"citingPaper": {...}}`` dicts.

## `get_references`

**Get References.** Read-only. Reaches outside the server.

Fetch papers referenced by the given paper (backward references).

Returns at most 1000 references per call; a larger ``limit`` is capped at
1000, so page further with ``offset``.

Should the call run long it continues in the background and returns a
job handle to poll with ``get_job_result``.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | `string` | required | Paper identifier (DOI, S2 ID, ARXIV:, etc.). |
| `fields` | `compact \| standard \| full` | `"compact"` | Field set preset for returned paper records. |
| `limit` | `integer` | `50` | Max results (max 1000). |
| `offset` | `integer` | `0` | Pagination offset. |

**Returns**

JSON with ``data`` list of ``{"citedPaper": {...}}`` dicts.

## `get_citation_graph`

**Get Citation Graph.** Read-only. Reaches outside the server.

Traverse the citation graph from one or more seed papers.

Performs BFS up to *depth* hops. Returns nodes (paper records) and
directed edges. Hard-caps at *`max_nodes`* to prevent runaway expansion.

Traversal makes one rate-limited request per node, so anything past a
shallow, narrow graph runs long: expect a job handle to poll with
``get_job_result`` rather than the graph itself.

A Semantic Scholar throttle defers the same walk. Poll the job handle;
the resumed graph does not mark the throttled request as partial.

A failed upstream request does not abort the walk. When one happens,
``stats.partial`` is true, ``stats.failed_requests`` counts them, and a
``warning`` key explains what was not fetched. Treat such a graph as
incomplete: a missing node or edge is unknown, not absent. This is
distinct from ``stats.truncated``, which means ``max_nodes`` stopped an
otherwise successful walk.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seed_ids` | `array of string` | required | 1-10 paper identifiers to start from. |
| `direction` | `citations \| references \| both` | `"citations"` | Expand via citations, references, or both. |
| `depth` | `integer` | `1` | Number of hops (1-3). |
| `max_nodes` | `integer` | `100` | Hard cap on total nodes returned. |
| `year_start` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Filter expanded papers to this year and later. |
| `year_end` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Filter expanded papers to this year and earlier. |
| `fields_of_study` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Filter by field. |
| `min_citations` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Minimum citation count of expanded papers. |

**Returns**

JSON ``{"nodes": [...], "edges": [...], "stats": {...}}``, where
``stats`` carries ``total_nodes``, ``total_edges``,
``depth_reached``, ``truncated``, ``partial`` and
``failed_requests``. A ``warning`` key joins the top level when
``partial`` is true.

## `find_bridge_papers`

**Find Bridge Papers.** Read-only. Reaches outside the server.

Find the shortest citation path between two papers.

Uses BFS over the citation/reference graph. Uses cached
citation and reference lists to minimise API calls.

The search walks outward one rate-limited request per node, so it
commonly runs long and returns a job handle to poll with
``get_job_result`` rather than the path itself.

A Semantic Scholar throttle defers the same search. Poll the job handle;
the resumed search does not mark the throttled request as partial.

A failed upstream request does not abort the search. When one happens,
``partial`` is true, ``failed_requests`` counts them, and a ``warning``
key explains what was not fetched. A partial ``{"found": false}`` is not
evidence that no path exists, and a partial ``{"found": true}`` path is
not guaranteed to be the shortest one.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_id` | `string` | required | Starting paper S2 ID. |
| `target_id` | `string` | required | Target paper S2 ID. |
| `max_depth` | `integer` | `4` | Maximum hops to search (default 4). |
| `direction` | `citations \| references \| both` | `"both"` | Expand via citations, references, or both. |

**Returns**

JSON ``{"found": true, "path": [...]}`` or ``{"found": false}``,
either way carrying ``partial`` and ``failed_requests``. A
``warning`` key joins them when ``partial`` is true.
